class: Loop detector ignores committed form progress
symptom: After LinkedIn was committed on My Information, the third Continue attempt was blocked before clicking.
root_cause: State fingerprints included only URL, step and field count, so changed answers did not reset the identical-state counter. A preferred-name checkbox also received a text name.
why_tests_missed: Circuit-breaker tests changed page structure instead of committed answers on the same step; preferred-name tests did not cover its presence toggle.
fix: Fingerprint visible form values and selections using a private digest, excluding passwords. Preferred-name presence toggles return checked or unchecked from the profile.
prevention: Test both real field progress and unchanged-state loop protection on the same wizard step.
